summary: Re-Volt entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Re-Volt
entries.definitive_edition: PC assets through RVGL, with Dreamcast/original-platform comparison if needed

emulation.emulator: RVGL for primary; Flycast/Project64/DuckStation only for port comparison
emulation.notes: Use RVGL for current route and original console emulators only for version comparisons.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: RVGL on modern PC for capture; original hardware for port-authentic behavior

primary.version: Steam/GOG PC assets upgraded through RVGL
primary.why: The PC release is the highest-fidelity base route, and RVGL is the current community-maintained cross-platform port that modernizes rendering, input, networking, and content support while still requiring legitimate game assets.
primary.how_to_play: Use a Steam/GOG or retail PC copy with RVGL. Record RVGL version, launcher/package source, soundtrack source, controller, resolution, online/multiplayer state, custom content, and whether Dreamcast/N64/PlayStation/mobile ports were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting console-specific behavior or Dreamcast content.
secondary.why: PC with RVGL is the best capture and maintenance route, but Dreamcast has notable port history.
They are not fidelity-first substitutes for the PC/RVGL route.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PC route with modern RVGL upgrade path.
all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity, capture, and community support route.

all_releases.fidelity: Console ports with platform-specific performance/content differences.
Modern native port/launcher route with current platform, rendering, controller, and multiplayer support.
all_releases.reason: primary: current preservation/capture route when paired with legal assets.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: RVGL is the best current route, but original platform content, soundtrack source, and custom-content state must be documented.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record RVGL version and asset source. Do not treat custom cars/tracks as part of a vanilla completion unless listed.
